name.zh: Echinochiton 连背板棘甲软体动物

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish serial dorsal plates bordered by large outward-pointing hollow spines in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以连续背板两侧排列向外伸的大空心刺搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

sources.title: Echinochiton dufoei, a new spiny Ordovician chiton
sources.supports: Echinochiton dorsal plates with large hollow spines and Ordovician occurrence.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism teaching interpretation: serial overlapping dorsal plates with integrated large lateral spines and conservative low soft girdle. Two restrained blunt-tip sections hint at hollow spines; no microscopic bone/scute counts, complete soft anatomy, exact fossil measurement or locomotor mechanism claimed. Muted palette, nominal 0.075 m body length and limited rounding are art choices. Original inventory biomes remains an empty array, not a universal habitat statement.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全体教学生活复原：连续叠覆背板、自然连接的大侧刺与保守低矮软质外套缘。两处克制钝端剖口提示刺内部空间，不主张微观骨片数、完整软组织、精确化石尺寸或运动机制。柔和配色、0.075米名义体长与圆润程度为美术设定。保留原始biomes空数组，不解释为通用生境。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
